title: Good place for solo travellers who want to slowly explore the city
likedText: The location was very convenient for travellers catching public transport
roomName: Standard Double Room with Shared Bathroom
replyText: Thank you for your lovely feedback! We’re glad you found our location convenient for getting around Sydney and using public transport. It’s great to hear that the property suited your trip as you explored the city at your own pace. We hope to welcome you back again on your next visit! 😊

Thank you for your feedback! We’re glad to hear you found the mattress and pillows comfortable. We’re sorry, however, that the bathroom was not up to our cleanliness standards. We take cleanliness seriously and will share your feedback with our housekeeping team to ensure this is properly addressed. We appreciate you bringing it to our attention and hope to provide you with a better experience next time.

title: Good. Allianz stadium was over the road so excellent for the footy game.
dislikedText: Key needs a tag. Easily lost on its own.
replyText:
Thank you for your feedback! We’re glad you enjoyed the excellent location, especially being so close to Allianz Stadium for the footy game.

We appreciate your suggestion regarding the room key and agree that adding a tag could make it easier to keep track of and less likely to be misplaced. We’ll certainly pass this feedback on to our team for consideration.

Thank you again for staying with us, and we hope to welcome you back for your next game or visit to Sydney!

title: Freo won so excellent close to Sch
replyText:
Thank you for your feedback! We’re glad you enjoyed our convenient location and that being close to the SCG was a highlight of your stay.

We’re sorry to hear about the stiffness of the front door. We appreciate you bringing this to our attention and will have our maintenance team look into it. We also understand your comment regarding breakfast and appreciate your feedback.

We hope to welcome you back again soon!
